text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We were able to safely finish our preparations for the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the race, ready to take on the challenge with confidence.
Around noon, we arrived at a hotel
not far from Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Incredible,
a hotel all the way up a mountain like this...!
choice_data_list: Apparently the view from the window is amazing!
Apparently the view from the window is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Hehe, I wonder if we can see all the way to the racetrack.
choice_data_list: (Thank goodness, I'm glad they're happy)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to do whatever I could to lift her spirits
before she takes on this major race—
or so I thought, but..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: The scenery from the window changes color completely between night and morning... It's so gorgeous, I was deeply moved!
choice_data_list: Ready to give it your all in the race now?
Think you can give it your best in the race now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's my first GⅠ race,
so I'm going to give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, the elevator's here!
Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Kya!?
...D-Did it stop...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah!!
Even the electricity...!
choice_data_list: Let's contact the hotel staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Upon asking, it turned out they still didn't know the cause of the elevator malfunction.
We would have to wait a little while for it to be resolved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, after being trapped in the elevator for over an hour, we were finally freed.
Unfortunately, however...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
You can't get the car out...?
choice_data_list: Looks like they're all out...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What should I do...?
Will I make it in time for the meetup...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Should I run?
If I sprint full speed down the mountain...!"
choice_data_list: I can't let you do something that dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's true, but... if there's no other way,
I can still run. So—"
choice_data_list: Buena, it's alright. Leave it to me!
Buena, it's alright. Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are two things I must consider:
getting Buena Vista there on time for the meeting,
and—making sure she gets a chance to refresh herself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
...*pant*...
choice_data_list: (She's getting anxious after all...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pursing her lips slightly, she breathes shallowly.
It's a truly minor gesture, but—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little longer...
until the race starts..."

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Phew...
Huff..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a gesture I'd seen her make countless times since childhood—an unconscious habit whenever she felt vulnerable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being trapped in a dark elevator must have completely exhausted her.
At this rate, she won't be able to show her true strength...
choice_data_list: (A way to clear both at the same time would be—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I just had an idea. It's all or nothing, but with a bit of luck—
choice_data_list: Buena, look, a cable car!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...!
Made it in time!
choice_data_list: Luck was on our side...!
Luck was really on our side...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was a cable car near the hotel, and we managed to hop on right as it was departing. What's more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The taxi called by the hotel was waiting at the station at the foot of the mountain... allowing us to arrive just before the meeting time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Still, that was a great idea! Taking the cable car, I mean.
choice_data_list: I was looking into it because I thought it might make you happy.
I was looking it up, thinking it might make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: The view on the way down was beautiful, wasn't it?
The scenery on the way down was beautiful, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"—I managed to catch it just in time, but...
Will I really make it?"
choice_data_list: "...Come on, Buena. Keep your chin up."
"...Come on, Buena. Keep your chin up."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? ...Whoa...!
There's still snow left... It's so magical and beautiful—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Because you were prepared for this...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because you prepared so much for me,
I'm able to run in this race, aren't I?
choice_data_list: I just got lucky, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And you were the one
who drew that to us!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...From here on out,
it's my turn to seize victory—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Don't worry, leave it to me.
You worked so hard for me, and I'm going to answer that.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Keep believing in me, just like you always have. If you do...
I can become stronger than ever before!
